facts.fact: The National Strategic Plan for the Modernisation of the Civil Status System 2025-2029, drawn up by BUNEC, was officially launched on 11 September 2025, per the human rights commission's statement of 10 August 2026.

The human rights commission (CDHC), in its statement of 10 August 2026, recommends that the government progressively allocate the necessary resources to BUNEC and the communes to complete the digital coverage of the national civil status file; it gives no amount and names no budget line.
